notes.title: 🕊️ Discover your Next Adventure: Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy 🛩️
notes.content:
Hello Detectives,

On [b]April 24th[/b], answer the call of exploration and set off for [b][i]Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy[/i][/b]!

Embark on the quest of a lifetime aboard the Hydrafloat and explore a forgotten Latin American country to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer. Make use of your curiosity and observational skills to solve intricate puzzles and bring back the White Birds into this mysterious land.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2429190/ss_87d5dc855bac62459ab5c7900c478a5b8c1f9620.1920x1080.jpg?t=1741885639[/img]
[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2429190/ss_7ecc9e5aca1d45ba7fd551b6ea47a6d51326a43f.1920x1080.jpg?t=1741885639[/img]

Released in 1999, [i]Amerzone[/i] had a great impact on the adventure genre and was ahead of its time with its ecological message. This game was also the first one Benoît Sokal created before the [i][b]Syberia[/b][/i] saga.

[h3]Witness the amazing overhaul work Microids Studio Paris did to go from the 1999 original to the 2025 version:[/h3]

notes.title: Blacksad Update 1.04
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

A new patch for Blacksad has already been released, here is what has been done:



•	Fixes freezes when Blacksad walks or when players perform actions
•	The game can now be launched properly if the Xbox One Gamepad is already used
•	Fixes a crash that would happen when players use the Deduction Menu during a loading screen
•	Pressing buttons during loading screens don’t create bugs anymore
•	Fixes a bug during the loading screen in the car while players are pressing RB multiple times
•	Fixes the bug encountered when players open the Menu while Blacksad is on the phone
•	Fixes a bug that would happen when John refuses to take Sonia’s case
•	The catsense is now properly displayed when players try to shoot the sniper 


Looking forward to hearing your feedback on this update!

notes.title: Blacksad back on (sound)track!
notes.content:
[h2]Official Blacksad OST[/h2]

You may or may not have noticed, but soundtracks on Steam are going under some nice changes that makes buying and listening to game soundtracks easier. 

So it is the perfect opportunity to discover or re-discover the acclaimed [b]beautiful jazzy music[/b] that deepens the noir tone of the game! 

From light tunes to intense musical outburst, journey along John Blacksad in the streets of 1950's New York.

[i]It is a raining night, and the town is dangerous, even for a hard-boiled detective.[/i]

[b]22 tracks from Juan Miguel Martin + an amazing main theme by Inon Zur[/b], composer for Fallout, Dragon Age, Prince of Persia, and Syberia!
